summary: Makes one cheap real call to each search provider and reports whether its key actually works.
purpose: Show when a search key is missing, revoked, out of quota, or unreachable, so research runs do not quietly degrade.
why: The header states that a key that is present can still be revoked or out of quota, and presence alone is not health.
how: For each provider, makes a minimal search with one result, classifies the outcome, and returns a report. It runs only from the live health endpoints, never on boot or per request. Only the first part of the file was included in this packet.
inputs: Provider keys from the environment and the storage module.
outputs: A verdict per provider with advice, collected into a report.
risks: Each check spends real search credits, so frequent runs cost money. Most of the file was not included here.
debug: Use the live health endpoints. Read the verdict and advice. Then check the matching key in the environment settings.
